themes.name: Neiro Hall

The home page opens on a dark band with the empty hall, then the programme as a filter-first directory of ticket stubs (perforated edge, mono date, seat line) filtered by genre and month with accessible pill buttons; without JavaScript every concert shows. Then the room on a dark band, the ticket prices and the journal. The footer is a programme-booklet colophon: the hall, credits, typefaces and a small contents list. With a full calendar, artists with portraits and a directory, the venue (hall, seating, foyer, access), tickets and box office, about, journal, newsletter and contact. themes.deviation: Planned as a gig-poster look in vivid orange #F15A24 on #1B1B1B and white, with footer F5. Changed at the user's request (elegant, restrained Japanese minimal, no bright colours, no gig-poster or street look): the orange is toned down to a desaturated rust #A5532F kept to small marks (rules, active filter, stub notch; #8A4426 for text links), on smoke stone #ECEAE6, paper #F5F4F1 and charcoal #19191B with warm grey #67635E (darkened slightly from #6F6B66 so meta text passes AA on stone) and soft brass #B39A6E. themes.name: Tsuya Lacquer
themes.description: A luxe, restrained store theme for a small urushi lacquerware workshop, with WooCommerce templates styled to match. Lacquer-black and deep brown-black bands alternate with warm ivory pages; one muted cinnabar is kept to small marks and the footer panel. Castoro for display and Epilogue for text. A hamburger-only header opens a full-screen lacquer-black overlay menu of large numbered serif items; the home page opens on a full-bleed photograph of a glossy black bowl. Product photographs carry a soft, still gloss highlight, and every product shows its layers-of-lacquer count, kept once as a product attribute. The Craft explains each coat, the Care guide how to live with lacquer; workshop, journal and contact pages. A split black and cinnabar footer holds the workshop details. The workshop address, hours and email, and the fallback shelf with prices and badge, live in synced patterns so each is edited once (WooCommerce optional: without it the shop page shows the shelf and orders go by email).
themes.deviation: Palette, fonts, style tags and H4 + F10 + L1 are as planned (combination unused). The muted cinnabar #8E3B2E is 6.6:1 on the ivory ground (AA for small text, used for links and labels) and ivory on cinnabar is 5.9:1 (footer panel), but it is only 2.2:1 on lacquer black, so on dark bands and the overlay menu small marks use a lighter cinnabar #C98371 (6.0:1 on #141211). Pale ivory #F5F0E8, sand #D8CEC0 and umber #5C524B (6.0:1) were added for panels, rules and quiet text. Both fonts verified OFL-1.1 in google/fonts (ofl/castoro, ofl/epilogue; no Reserved Font Name); variable fonts instanced to Castoro 400-500 and Epilogue 300-600 and subset to Latin WOFF2.
